plan: Drive: from Old Bella Bella, about 89 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.49614, -127.2707, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.1 km E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 445 m, about 146 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 1.9 km NW of the spot at 423 m (52.49715, -127.21969). Water: unnamed lake 150 m N (estimate).
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2018 cutblock (880 m SW) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-9, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
